context.body: Selected for the reader trail because “Darkness, a torn veil, a final prayer, and people watching” preserves a distinct parallel witness source unit within death witness.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Darkness covers the land, the sun is darkened, the veil tears, Jesus entrusts his spirit and dies, and the centurion, crowds, acquaintances, and women respond.
observations.label: Darkness, a torn veil, a final prayer, and people watching: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps jesus, darkness, veil visible within its Crucifixion evidence.
observations.label: Darkness, a torn veil, a final prayer, and people watching: action, promise, or consequence

payload.posture: Read Luke 23:44–49 as its own death, signs, and witnesses crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: This witness selects its own people, actions, words, and sequence around the Crucifixion without explaining every difference from the other witnesses.
payload.title: Darkness, a torn veil, a final prayer, and people watching
